title: Northwind Robotics and Kestrel Freight sign three-year deployment deal
text:
Kestrel Freight will install 60 Northwind Robotics picking robots across four of its hubs in the Netherlands and Germany under a three-year agreement announced on Thursday.

The first robots will go into Kestrel's Venlo hub in the first quarter of 2027. Financial terms were not disclosed.

Kestrel Freight said it chose Northwind after a six-month trial at its Duisburg site, where the robots handled about a third of all picks. It is the largest single order Northwind Robotics has announced.
